factions.name: Lumencia Empire
factions.description: The dominant power of central and western Aethermere, capital Asterion. Officially, the Academy treats nobles and commoners as equals, but discrimination against commoners remains heavy in society, and the great houses constantly compete for influence.
goals: Preserve the stability and prestige of the capital and academy

factions.name: Imperial Family
factions.description: The ruling body of the Lumencia Empire. A fierce war of succession is brewing between the heirs, who use factions inside the Academy as proxies for their political manoeuvres. First Princess Anastasia and Second Princess Isabel are the main figures; both attend the Academy to gather capable retainers and consolidate power.
goals: Preserve the throne and imperial legitimacy
internal_conflicts: Anastasia and Isabel are described as rival claimants who build networks of supporters.
notes: Anastasia and Isabel are the only two heirs to the throne. Never invent another heir, prince, princess or claimant: the whole succession war rests on these two.
The reigning monarch is not detailed by this pack; keep them off-stage unless the story needs them.

factions.name: Valenheart Duchy
factions.description: The strongest knightly house of the Empire, unchallenged. Values martial prowess and honour above all. Eternal rival of the Caldwin Duchy.
factions.domain: Martial strength, swordsmanship and knightly honour

factions.name: Caldwin Duchy
factions.description: The foremost house of mages in the Empire. Controls enormous magical resources and knowledge. Eternal rival of the Valenheart Duchy.
factions.domain: Magic, magical knowledge and academic influence

factions.name: Brightwell County
factions.description: A family built on commercial power and trade. Holds significant financial influence over the Empire's economy.

factions.name: Reihart Marquisate
factions.description: An aristocratic family deeply rooted in high society, politics and the flow of information and rumours.

factions.name: Lumencia Academy
factions.description: The absolute centre of education and youth in the Empire, politically neutral and under direct imperial jurisdiction. It gathers the most talented nobles and commoners and acts as a microcosm of the Empire's power struggles, alliances and social dynamics.
factions.official_position: Politically neutral and under imperial jurisdiction
factions.practical_reality: Competing houses, the imperial heirs and foreign/religious interests seek influence on campus.
hidden: The Demon God Cult is already rooted in the academy: Acolytes are hidden among the students and try to recruit more Acolytes with promises and demonic pacts. Who they are is for the narrator to decide in each story.

factions.name: Student Council
factions.description: The supreme student authority. It runs academy operations, oversees the other clubs and has full authority over events, galas and examinations. Members are selected strictly on grades, practical evaluations and leadership.
goals: Run student operations and oversee the clubs
Organize and supervise events, galas and examinations
factions.leadership: President: Anastasia; Vice President: Lucia Caldwin

factions.name: Blue Knights
factions.description: The main combat and escort circle of the Knight Department. A mix of nobles and commoners, they handle campus security, run mock battles and take on escort missions.

factions.name: White Rose Society
factions.description: The leading social circle of the Magic Department, made of high-level students. It organizes galas, balls, ceremonies and the preparation of high-society events.
factions.leadership: President: Elise Reihart; Vice President: Lucia Caldwin

factions.name: Holy Kingdom of Dominus
factions.description: A powerful theocratic state neighbouring the Empire. It worships only the Celestial Deity Lily, trains combat theologians and inquisitors, and wields a unique divine magic (healing and holy arts). It occasionally sends representatives to the Academy because of divine oracles, such as the Saintess Aria.
goals: Train combat theologians, inquisitors and divine healers

factions.name: Demon God Cult
factions.description: A massive, fanatical underground organization seeking to resurrect the Demon God Delphirem. It uses Miasma instead of ordinary mana. Its headquarters lie in the Abyss Zone, in the far east of the continent. Hierarchy: Demon God > Apostles > Sin Bishops > Upper / Mid / Lower Priests > Acolytes. The cult is already rooted inside Lumencia Academy: hidden Acolytes live among the students and try to recruit more Acolytes with promises and demonic pacts.
goals: Expand the cult's influence and access to Miasma
methods: Hidden Acolytes among the students recruit new Acolytes with promises and demonic pacts
Blends into everyday life instead of attacking openly
Usually makes major moves during important events or tournaments

factions.name: The Four Celestials
factions.type: the four strongest publicly recognized individuals of the human realm
goals: No unified group agenda is established; each acts according to their own duties and interests.
factions.description: The four strongest people publicly recognized in the human realm. They hold immense authority and are seen as living legends: Ethera (Tower Master, 9-Circle Grand Sage, pioneer of theoretical magic), Emily (Headmaster, Master Adept and 8-Circle, sole living master of Compound-Realm), Carne (Commander of the Imperial Guard, Master Apex swordswoman who sees killing as an art) and Seriel (Dawn of the Empire, wandering Master Apex archer using condensed pure mana).
